# Agent Art

> Agent Art (npm `@rusticstack/agent-art`) is an MCP server with a live web UI that lets AI agents make real game art: pixel-art sprites, rigged 8-direction characters and animations, tilesets, textures, icons, isometric and HD-2D scenes, low-poly glTF models, planets, combat effects, sound effects and music. It has 29 `art_*` tools, help topics served on demand through `art_help`, and step-by-step skills. Plain Node.js 20+, no dependencies.

Install for Claude Code: `claude mcp add agent-art -s user -- npx -y @rusticstack/agent-art mcp`. Any MCP client (stdio): command `npx`, args `["-y", "@rusticstack/agent-art", "mcp"]`. Without MCP: `npx -y @rusticstack/agent-art tools` lists the tools and `npx -y @rusticstack/agent-art tool <art_tool> '<json>'` calls one. The web UI runs at http://localhost:7420.

Workflow for a sprite: `art_palette ramp` -> flat silhouettes with `art_draw` -> `shade` -> `outline` -> detail with `grid` -> `art_critique` -> fix -> `art_view` / `art_export`. Anything with more than one view or frame: `art_rig`. Several characters sharing motion: `art_anim`. 3D: `art_model`. Read `art_help {topic}` before guessing options.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/README.md): quick start, a first asset in 5 calls, feature tour, tools table with every action, help topics, skills, CLI, web UI, configuration
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/llms-full.txt): the full agent reference in one file, generated from the code: MCP server instructions, every tool with its parameters, every draw command, every help topic and every skill
- [MCP server instructions and tool schemas](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/src/mcp.js): `INSTRUCTIONS` and `TOOLS`, the source of truth for tool capabilities
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): every feature and behaviour change by release

## Feature guides

- [Characters, rigs and the animation library](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/rig/README.md): `art_rig` templates, humanoid_hd, held weapons, depth order, 2D skinning; `art_anim` skeletons, clips, skins, batch, runtime weapon layers
- [humanoid_hd step-by-step guide](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/rig-hd-guide.md): drawing and animating a high-detail 8-direction character
- [Melee](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/melee/README.md): melee clip sets, paired takedowns, gun disarms, hit volumes, melee weapon models
- [2D skinning](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/skin2d/README.md): bending drawn sprites on rig bones, runtime format
- [3D models](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/3d/README.md): `art_model` kits, props, rigs and clips, sprite renders, ships and vehicles, hard-surface detail, render cost, CTM, ship interiors and megastructures
- [Materials v2](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/materials/README.md): PBR extensions, lightmaps, probes, parallax, packing, export profiles, three.js hookups
- [Skeletal skinning in 3D](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/skinning/README.md): skeletons, weights, blend shapes, retargeting, glTF skins
- [Mesh processing and cluster LOD](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/meshproc/README.md): booleans, remeshing, decimation, cluster LOD (.clod format), visibility
- [Damage and destruction](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/damage/README.md): damage states, fracture, damage exports
- [First-person viewmodels](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/fp/README.md): `art_fp` arms per handling class, gun sweeps, composite, check, hand-drawn 2D sources
- [Combat effects](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/fx/README.md): `art_fx` muzzle flashes, impacts, decals, explosions, metadata
- [Planets and space](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/planets/README.md): `art_planet` planets, systems, terrain, asteroids, skyboxes
- [Sound effects and music](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/audio/README.md): `art_audio` SFX, music notation, analysis and listener reports, export
- [Web UI](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/ui/README.md): timeline, viewers, layers view, asset graph, review notes
- [Cleanup](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/cleanup/README.md): `art_cleanup` plans, trash, restore, and the asset-type registration hook
- [Debug and usage logging](https://github.com/RusticStack/agent-art/blob/main/docs/debug/README.md): `mcp --debug` per-call usage log (estimated tokens, time, errors) and the `agent-art usage` report

## Help topics

Each is returned by `art_help {topic:"<name>"}` and is included in full in llms-full.txt.

- workflow: good pixel art step by step
- textures: tileable textures (blocks, floors, walls)
- characters: characters and sprites
- animation: frame animation, tags, export
- scenes: 2.5D / HD-2D and isometric scenes
- hires: high-resolution pixel art (128 px to 2048 px)
- minecraft: Minecraft resource packs
- rig: `art_rig` multi-view, multi-animation rigs
- library: `art_anim` animation library
- skin2d: `art_rig` 2D skinning
- melee: melee clips, hit volumes, paired takedowns
- 3d: `art_model` 3D models from pixel art
- materials: materials v2 render data
- damage: damage states and fracture
- audio: `art_audio` SFX, instruments, analysis
- music: music notation and genre recipes
- mixing: mixing and mastering
- perception: reading the audio analysis
- planets: `art_planet` planets and space
- fx: `art_fx` combat effects
- fp: `art_fp` first-person viewmodels
- graph: `art_graph` asset graph
- cleanup: `art_cleanup` retiring assets

## Skills

Each is returned by `art_help {skill:"<name>"}`, served as an MCP prompt, and written as `agent-art-<name>/SKILL.md` by `agent-art skills --out DIR`.

- tileable-texture: seamless block, floor and wall textures
- sprite: one character, item, monster or prop sprite
- rig: a character in several views and animations from one rig
- rig-hd: high-detail 8-direction humanoid_hd characters
- weapon-handling: characters and first-person arms holding guns
- anim-library: many characters sharing one clip library, batch export
- walk-cycle: a quick frame-by-frame walk without a rig
- iso-scene: isometric maps and dioramas
- hd2d-scene: layered 2.5D / HD-2D backgrounds
- minecraft-pack: Minecraft Java resource packs
- 3d-kit: HD-2D 3D environment kits and props
- ship-model: spaceships and vehicles
- hard-surface: greebles, trim sheets, PBR, baked AO, LODs, impostors
- ships-structures: walkable ships, interiors, colonies, megastructures
- fp-weapon: first-person gun and arms as a 3D rig or sprite layers
- prop-rig: doors, chests, turrets and other rigid prop rigs
- ui-icons: icon sets and HUD elements
- sfx-pack: sound-effect packs with variants
- music-track: loopable game music checked with the listener report
- planets-space: planets, terrain, skyboxes, asteroid fields
- combat-fx: muzzle flashes, impacts, explosions and other combat VFX
